candidates.name: 裹尸囚徒
candidates.originalPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone identity mother image candidate for a normal-tier horror dungeon monster in a realistic Phaser game. This is a creature asset reference, not an illustration of a scene.
Art direction: deeply uncanny, abstract eldritch cosmic horror, biologically alien while physically tangible; less recognizable human in costume, more an impossible organism with a stable, intentionally designed anatomy. A modest ordinary enemy, not a giant boss. High-detail realistic PBR 3D game render: convincing worn skin, dry fibrous tissue, chalky mineralized bone, rough cloth where specified; believable mass, contact, articulations. Restrained desaturated hues and a clear readable silhouette at small game scale. No exposed bloody wounds or gore.
Composition: square image, exactly ONE complete creature in a relaxed animation-ready idle stance, body oriented to the RIGHT in a near-side three-quarter view, camera sees right-facing profile and a little of the chest, orthographic-style camera at body height with only slight elevation. Whole body including every foot and all protrusions; occupy approximately 65% of image height and at most 65% width with generous empty white margins. Both supporting feet meet the same horizontal baseline. Soft even diffuse studio illumination reveals form and material without cinematic effects.
Backdrop: completely flat pure white #FFFFFF, no horizon, no ground plane visible, NO cast shadow, no contact shadow, no ambient-occlusion puddle, no reflection.
Constraints: one pose only, no montage, no labels, no text, no border, no watermark. No floating parts, no scenic props, no particles, no glow, no magic aura. Not cartoon, not anime, not painterly, not a miniature, not glossy plastic, not a robot. Intentional alien anatomy must remain continuous and feasible to animate; no tangled tentacle pile, no random extra limbs.
Creature identity: THE SHROUD THRALL. A narrow stooped biped with precisely two long arms and two short sturdy legs. The shoulders rise directly into a tall, bent cocoon head with no recognizable face, no eyes, and no visible human neck. Its head is made of three large nested inward-folding tissue-and-shroud lamellae; a deep charcoal seam spirals asymmetrically into the upper head like a sealed biological aperture, not a wound or an open toothy mouth. Pale dirty linen strips have grown into ash-grey leathery skin, forming large diagonal bands across the tapered upper torso, with very sparse small ivory growths near the spine. Long heavy forearms hang near the knees, each ending in one simple broad hand with three thick joined-looking but separately readable blunt fingers. Wrist cuffs are dark corroded iron fixed snugly, with NO dangling chains. Small flat broad feet are bare and firmly planted. Its silhouette should feel like a funerary cocoon that learned to stand and strike, not a conventional bandaged zombie or Egyptian mummy. Neutral idle: slight forward lean, arms loose and apart from torso, head subtly bent toward the right. Color identity: chalk-white wraps, ash-grey hide, charcoal cavity, very restrained rusty brown cuffs. No weapons.

Creature identity: THE COFFIN WARD. A compact broad biped with precisely two stout legs and two arms. A large narrow upright coffin-shaped dermal shield grows from the LEFT shoulder and forearm and is held slightly forward toward the right-facing direction, without hiding the entire torso. This is one continuous hinged anatomical plate, half petrified wood-grain, half layered chalk-grey bone, with coffin-like tapered shoulders, three broad weathered transverse mineral ridges, and a handful of embedded oxidized iron fasteners. Not a carried ordinary wooden door. Behind it a low off-center featureless bud-like head emerges under the hunched right shoulder, bearing one horizontal sealed sensory fold and no human face. The trunk is compressed and asymmetrical, clad in dark dry hide with stout supporting joint anatomy. RIGHT arm remains fully readable behind/beside the shield and terminates in a dense knotted mineralized club fist, not a separate handheld hammer. Wide two-toed feet support its heavy torso. Idle pose: the shield arm relaxed but protective, club fist lowered, no attack motion. Strong readable asymmetric silhouette, more ossuary organism than an armored soldier. Color identity: faded bone-grey shield, dark umber hide, almost black recessed head, sparse oxidized iron details. No giant spikes, no extra mouths, no medieval armor suit.

Creature identity: THE OSSUARY THROWER. A very slender erect alien biped with precisely two long arms and two legs, a pinched waist and a forward-curved upper torso. No recognizable human skull. Its elongated head is a small oblique wedge of smooth pale bone with an offset seam where the face should be, wrapped on the back by a close-fitting dark fibrous hood grown from its skin. Beneath the chest is an EXTERNAL integral rib-rack: six sturdy interleaved ivory slats form a closed dry ossuary-like container, not exposed organs or an open wound. Three short thick removable bone darts are neatly nested in this rack, all pointing consistently upward and held flush to its body. One hand with three long fingers calmly holds ONE separate short bone dart at waist height pointing right; the other rests beside the rack, with both elbows separated and clearly articulated for later animation. Lower trunk tapers into a split knee-length charcoal fibrous apron fused to its hips, legs and broad toe pads clearly visible below. Very subtle outward bow to forearms, convincing tendons and dry papery skin rather than tentacles. Shape language: thin diagonal head, vertical rib-case, long sparse limbs. It should feel like an unsettling living reliquary rather than a hooded human necromancer. Color identity: old ivory bone, cold grey skin, faded charcoal fibrous mantle. No magic, no staff, no crossbow, no decorative antlers, no spiky crown, no ornate jewelry.

Creature identity: THE LIVING KNELL ATTENDANT. A low stooped two-legged organism with precisely two arms, broad upper body and a small tucked-in head. Its central thorax is a single downward-flaring HOLLOW BELL-SHAPED organic resonance shell, about torso size: dark mineralized horn with muted weathered bronze-like surface patches, chalky growth rings and a little dull verdigris in seams. This shell is anatomically fused into the shoulder girdle and spine, not a separate bell strapped to a normal human. The flared lower rim and the shadowed opening are clearly visible above the pelvis, hollow and dry, with no exposed organs. A small blind folded head peeks forward from beneath a drooping asymmetrical dark fibrous cowl on top of the shell; no normal human face and no antlers. Two long sinewy arms emerge from the shoulders; the near-side hand has three blunt fingers holding a short simple bone striker beside the bell rim, poised neutrally but NOT striking. The other arm hangs relaxed. Bent powerful knees and two broad bare feet stabilize the weight; a few short ragged mantle strips cling closely to the hips and do not trail on the floor. The feeling is a patient, disturbing living funeral instrument, not a ghost, priest, robot, or giant boss. Color identity: soot-brown fibrous skin, dull ancient-bronze mineral shell, tiny verdigris traces, ivory striker. No runes, no religious symbols, no visible sound waves, no floating ropes, no chains.
